type_surface:
    name: Type-surface evidence authentication
    needs: static
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Free hosted runner disk for the evidence checkout
        run: |
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          df -h /
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /.github/
            /acceptance/
            /config/
            /containers/
            /demos/
            /nix/
            /notices/
            /patches/
            /poc/
            /schema/
            /scripts/
            /site/
            /src/
            /tests/
            /docs/
            !/docs/evidence/*
            /docs/evidence/*.json
            /docs/evidence/*.md
            /docs/evidence/*.xml
            /docs/evidence/*/index.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Authenticate the type-surface corpus once
        run: |
          node scripts/create-core-type-surface-evidence-receipt.mjs \
            --receipt build/core-type-surface/receipt.json \
            --manifest build/core-type-surface/materialization.json \
            --commit "${{ github.sha }}"
      - name: Preserve the exact type-surface receipt
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: core-type-surface-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/core-type-surface
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7

- name: Restore the authenticated type-surface receipt
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: core-type-surface-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/core-type-surface
